# Test files

Generated by `tools/make_testdata.py`: 32 TGA files covering every image type, bit depth, RLE, colour map
entry size, origin and the alpha rules, with the expected decoding in `expected/`.

```
python tools/make_testdata.py testdata                 # rewrite them
python tools/make_testdata.py testdata --check out     # compare tga2png output (out/*.png) with expected/
```
